title: Another tab's busy post does not say which chat asked; dots show in a mirrored New chat
evidence: Fixed (US-15 AC17d): each state post carries `asked` and `shown` chat keys; widget-src/src/hooks/chatBusy.ts holds other tabs' sends as one union with a pure transition, and the dots draw only where the asked key matches the chat shown (a new chat's key through the mirror of its sender). Older bundles lock Send and draw no dots (not today's fallback: no dots on the wrong chat). Was: Owner UI. Fable ruled R7 (b) 2026-11-12 on the chat-turn reducer: slice 2 limits the US-15 AC7a amendment to the tab that asked. Other tabs still draw the dots from othersBusy (useChatBusy) under whatever chat they show, so tab 1 sends, then New chat, and tab 2 mirrors the new chat with dots for the length of the reply. Fix (R7 a): each busy post carries the sender's asked key, the mirror carries its shown key, and dots draw only where they match; older bundles fall back to today. Its own slice after slice 4 (widget-src/src/hooks/useChatState.ts `replying`, lib/chat-sync.ts).
